newsitem.title: THAILAND: New Thai finmin sworn in at ceremony.
newsitem.headline: New Thai finmin sworn in at ceremony.

text.p: New Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya was sworn in on Monday at a formal ceremony by King Bhumibol Adulyadej at a palace in Hua Hin, about 200 km (125 miles) south of Bangkok, government officials said.

The new minister, who was named last Friday after royal assent for his job was obtained by the government, replaces Amnuay Viravan who quit after political differences with his rivals in the ruling six-party coalition government.

Thanong takes over at a critical time for Thailand as it goes through its worst economic crisis in over a decade with troubles in its finance and property sectors, an embattled baht that has come under speculative attack and a stock market at its lowest in eight years.
The new minister is a low profile banker who was president of Thai Military bank Plc.
